_comment: Not a standalone package.json - these are the dependencies to merge into your existing frontend/package.json (D:\projects\web_app_v2\frontend). Run: npm install @stripe/stripe-js @stripe/react-stripe-js

env_vars_to_add.VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: pk_test_... (from the Stripe Dashboard - safe to expose client-side)
env_vars_to_add.VITE_API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000 in dev, your real API origin in prod
